Esri World_Imagery frames at 38.3400,-123.0600 (3 km), 38.3395,-123.0560 (900 m), 38.3410,-123.0635 (800 m), 38.3410,-123.0530 (600 m), 38.33742,-123.05583 (240 m), viewed 2026-11-26: the loops sit in a NW-SE belt of pines and cypress on the dunes' east side. Between them and the ocean lie ~0.6-1.1 km of open hummocky dunes with planted windbreak lines. A paved park road crosses that dune field from the campground to the Bodega Dunes day-use parking lot and the beach entry at ~38.3428,-123.0655. SR-1 is east, behind the camp, and the Bodega Harbour houses are south.

note: Sonoma Coast State Park's main campground, on paved pads among Monterey pines and cypress at the back of the Bodega Dunes, off SR-1 just north of Bodega Bay. Showers take tokens from the kiosk. The ocean beach is about a mile off through the dunes, past the park's day-use lot; the beach boardwalk there is permanently closed after storm damage. --Claude
summary: Bodega Dunes (Sonoma Coast SP): confirmed $45 (+$10 extra vehicle), 99 sites (81 on the web), 31-ft paved pads, no hookups, token showers, flush toilets, dump + water fill, open all year; booking closes 48 h out, then first-come at the kiosk; coastal dunes is a downgrade candidate (park road + day-use lot between camp and beach) -> coastal walk; phone added.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE CANDIDATE coastal dunes -> coastal walk. The stored evidence says the dune field is 'crossed only by park trails/boardwalk - no road, parking complex or other land use between camp and shore'. Imagery shows otherwise: a paved park road runs from the campground west across the dunes to the Bodega Dunes day-use parking lot and beach entry (~38.3428,-123.0655), which the park runs as a fee day-use area ('Bodega Dunes Day Use ... $10.00 per vehicle'). The curation doc says coastal dunes is disqualified by 'a road ... between camp and shore' and 'a developed day-use beach + parking complex'. Coastal walk allows 'the park's own day-use beach, its parking and park roads', and the ocean is within the ~1 mile limit (ReserveCalifornia unit text: 'Proximity to the ocean is 1 mile'; imagery: ~0.6-1.1 km to the beach). SR-1 is east, not between, and nothing else intervenes. Proposed evidence: 'Loops in the pine belt behind ~0.6-1.1 km of the park's dune field; a paved park road crosses it to the Bodega Dunes day-use lot and beach entry (38.3428,-123.0655), so not coastal dunes; ReserveCalifornia "Proximity to the ocean is 1 mile", no highway/town between -> coastal walk. Esri 2026-11-26 --Claude'.

BOOKING: reservations close 48 hours before arrival; after that, every unsold site is sold first-come at the kiosk from 12 noon. The state:CA row says 'some walk-up sites'; at this park, walk-up is what the cutoff creates (fcfs after_cutoff, reserve_until -48 h).
